Node es-data-4 in cluster log-central (Elasticsearch 7.17.11, 12 data nodes, 30GB heap on 64GB hosts) has left and rejoined five times since 03:00; each exit triggers a shard reallocation storm, recovery traffic saturates NICs and search p99 spikes to 12s. Users of the search API behind lb-es.prod (four nodes es-prod-1..4, Elasticsearch 7.17.8) report the same query alternating between ~41.2M hits and 0 hits on refresh ever since es-prod-4 was reprovisioned at 02:00. db-ledger-r1 (8.0.37, 16 parallel applier workers) alerted at 02:00: Seconds_Behind_Source 2,410 and climbing roughly 55s per minute since 01:20. gw-prod-7 (32G, 16 cores) serves api-gateway with p99 up from 40ms to 780ms since 06:00. scoring-batch on ml-prod-4 dies at 03:00 with exit 137; dmesg confirms a memcg OOM at its 8G limit with anon-rss 7.9G.
